Lesson 30 Remote Control - Introduction to
                              APP

30.1 Overview

In this lesson, we will show you how to control the robot via the APP, covering the program
service startup, APP connection process and full function introduction -- all to make robot
control more convenient and intuitive.

30.2 APP Connection Preparation

1.Download the APP on your mobile phone: open the app store, search for "Adeept", then click
to download and install it. (For Android phones, you can obtain the Adeept.apk file from the
APP directory in the tutorial for installation.)

2.By default, we have configured the WebServer.py service program to start automatically. If you
want to control the robot via the APP, you must switch to the APPServer.py service program.
Execute the following command to stop the running program:
sudo killall python3

                                                                                                             support@adeept.com
     2
Run the APPServer.py service program. After successful startup, the Raspberry Pi's IP address
will be displayed on the command terminal or OLED screen:
sudo python3 Adeept_4WD_Smart_Car_for_RPi/Server/Server_OrdinaryWheels/APPServer.py

Note: If you want the APPServer.py program to run automatically on boot, you only need to
modify the startup.sh script.
sudo nano startup.sh

Change WebServer.py to APPServer.py in the script.

Press Ctrl+X, then enter Y, Enter to save and exit.
Enter the following commands to test running the program -- if it starts normally, the
configuration is successful:
sudo killall python3
./startup.sh

                                                                                                             support@adeept.com
     3

3. Connect to WiFi and ensure that your operating device and the Raspberry Pi are on the same
LAN.(I'm using the office LAN here; you should connect to your own network instead.)

4. Open the APP, enter the product page, tap ADR036-Ordinary to access the Robot control
interface.

                                                                                                             support@adeept.com
     4

5. Enter the Raspberry Pi's IP address in the IP field (the default port is 8888), then tap the
'Connect' button.

                                                                                                             support@adeept.com
     5
6. After a successful connection, the camera feed will be displayed on your mobile phone, and
you can then control the robot normally.

30.3 Function Introduction

                            Vision Line-following Function Switch:
                            Enables switching between black and
                            white color modes. L1 and L2 can be
                            used to adjust the positions of the
                            two reference lines in the video feed.
                            The vision line-following function is
                            significantly affected by light
                            conditions.

                            Color Recognition Function Switch:
                            Allows selection of the target color
                            for recognition.

                            Robot Movement Control Joystick

                            support@adeept.com

                                                                              Function Control: e.g., automatic
